note: Constants of bench/ingest.py, kept out of the code (hardcode ratchet, docs/CONFIG.md). Tags: SRC = read from the first-party source in 'source'; SNIP = sample output read from third-party files; INF = engineering choice of this tool, not a fact about hardware; UNVERIFIED = no source found.

throttled_roles.note: names of the bit positions above for the code

units.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/torvalds/linux/master/Documentation/ABI/testing/sysfs-class-hwmon (in: millivolt, curr: milliampere, temp: millidegree Celsius, power: microWatt)
units.note: the thermal zone value is divided by 1000 (SRC overclocking.adoc: cat /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp)

kernel_patterns.usb_found: usb (\S+): New USB device found, idVendor=([0-9a-fA-F]+), idProduct=([0-9a-fA-F]+)
kernel_patterns.usb_enum_fail: (device descriptor read/\w+, error -?\d+|unable to enumerate USB device|device not accepting address \d+, error -?\d+|connect-debounce failed|Cannot enable\. Maybe the USB cable is bad\?|disabled by hub \(EMI\?\), re-enabling)
kernel_patterns.note: device-name prefixes (usb 1-1:, hwmon hwmon1:) are the dev_printk convention (INF); the older firmware driver text 'Under-voltage detected!' is accepted by the optional hyphen (UNVERIFIED which kernels print it)

kernel_time.source: util-linux dmesg(1) default '[secs.usecs]' and -T forms; journalctl -o short-iso; format of -T/ISO lines UNVERIFIED here, parsed best-effort
kernel_time.dmesg_T_is_local_time: dmesg -T prints local time; this tool assumes UTC and says so in the report (INF)

vcgencmd_patterns.source: sample outputs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/geerlingguy/jeffgeerling-com/f448c239f7fbe72c16e79feb30e0ae4eb708d068/content/blog/2023/10/overclocking-and-underclocking-raspberry-pi-5/index.md (throttled=0x0, temp=39.5'C, pmic_read_adc rail lines); https://github.com/ebaauw/homebridge-rpi README (frequency(48)=..., temp=52.5'C); the output is produced by closed VideoCore firmware, vcgencmd.c only prints the reply (SRC https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raspberrypi/utils/master/vcgencmd/vcgencmd.c)
vcgencmd_patterns.note: the get_config reply format 'key=value' is UNVERIFIED for usb_max_current_enable (the docs only name the command)

pmic.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raspberrypi/documentation/master/documentation/asciidoc/computers/config_txt/overclocking.adoc (vcgencmd pmic_read_adc EXT5V_V); power-supplies.adoc: USB current bypasses the PMIC and is not visible
pmic.accuracy: UNVERIFIED: ADC accuracy and sampling are not documented

dt_chosen_power.note: values are read as big-endian integers (device-tree cells, INF); a length other than 4 bytes is reported raw and not interpreted

thresholds.soft_temp_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raspberrypi/documentation/master/documentation/asciidoc/computers/config_txt/overclocking.adoc ('between 80 and 85 C the Arm cores will be throttled back'); the Pi 3 B+ soft limit is 60 C by default (same file)
thresholds.usb_budget_source: power-supplies.adoc: Pi 5 gives 1.6 A to USB with a 5 A (25 W) supply, otherwise 600 mA
thresholds.note: analysis limits chosen by the author of this tool (INF), not hardware facts; change them here, not in the code

board_models.note: substrings of /proc/device-tree/model; the exact strings are UNVERIFIED here

radio_hints.note: hints only; the radio may be pointed at explicitly with --radio-path

wfb_stats.ports: stats_port (msgpack, wfb-cli) and api_port (JSON lines) of the wfb-ng profile
wfb_stats.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/svpcom/wfb-ng/master/wfb_ng/protocols.py (StatisticsJSONProtocol: one JSON object per line; rx: packets{all,out,session,fec_rec,lost,dec_err,bad,data,uniq,all_bytes,out_bytes}=[delta,total], rx_ant_stats[{ant,freq,mcs,bw,pkt_recv,rssi_*,snr_*}]; tx: packets{injected,incoming,fec_timeouts,dropped,truncated}, tx_ant_stats); https://raw.githubusercontent.com/svpcom/wfb-ng/master/wfb_ng/cli.py (wfb-cli is a curses UI over the msgpack stream, its screen is not parseable)
wfb_stats.rf_temperature: /proc/net/<rtl88x2eu|rtl88x2cu>/<wlan>/thermal_state lines 'rf_path:N, temperature:T' (SRC protocols.py RFTempMeter); AU drivers: UNVERIFIED
